name: Imakash Mobile Bottom Menu
author: imakash

sections.description:
Imakash Mobile Bottom Menu adds a clean, app-like bottom navigation bar for mobile users.

Features:

  • Mobile-only bottom navigation
  • Custom links (Home, Shop, Track, Account, WhatsApp)
  • Active menu highlight
  • Custom colors from admin panel
  • Lightweight and fast
  • No external dependencies

Perfect for eCommerce, service websites, and landing pages.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/imakash-mobile-bottom-menu directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to “Mobile Bottom Menu” in admin
  4. Configure your menu links and colors
sections.faq:
Does it work on desktop?

No, it is designed only for mobile devices.

Can I customize menu links?

Yes, you can change links from the admin panel.
